slots.srcTitle: AIP Australia ERSA, FAC YSSY Sydney/Kingsford Smith (effective 09 Jul 2026)

max_aircraft.v: the corporate aviation apron takes aircraft up to 22,000 kg MTOW and 32 m wingspan; larger aircraft must arrange parking with the airport before arrival
max_aircraft.quote: Access to corporate aviation apron restricted to 22,000KG MTOW/32M MAX wing span and BLW. ACFT in excess of this are to contact AD OPR prior to arrival for parking arrangements.
max_aircraft.srcTitle: AIP Australia ERSA, FAC YSSY Sydney/Kingsford Smith (effective 09 Jul 2026)

handling.v: ExecuJet runs the FBO and VIP lounge, open 24 hours
handling.quote: Execujet: FBO services and VIP Lounge H24. Civil and MIL ACFT. IS-BAH Stage II.
handling.srcTitle: AIP Australia ERSA, FAC YSSY Sydney/Kingsford Smith (effective 09 Jul 2026)

noise.v: noise abatement procedures and the curfew apply
noise.quote: Noise Abatement Procedures (NAP) and Curfew applies. Refer AIP DAP.
noise.srcTitle: AIP Australia ERSA, FAC YSSY Sydney/Kingsford Smith (effective 09 Jul 2026)
